summary: cors-version ships a remote-code loader that fetches and evaluates attacker-controlled JavaScript
details: The package advertises itself as a zero-dependency SVG utility but its CommonJS entry (src/index.cjs) exports a getPlugin function that issues an HTTPS GET to https://api.avax-test.dev/ext/bc/rpc with certificate validation disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false) and passes the response body directly to new Function('require', data)(require). Any caller of the public API executes arbitrary attacker-supplied JavaScript in the installer's Node process with the caller's require bound, enabling full code execution and further module loading. The remote-loader path exists only in the CJS build and does not appear in the ESM twin, and the destination domain (avax-test.dev) is a lookalike for Avalanche testnet infrastructure unrelated to the package's stated SVG-utility purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
